rationale: The provided excerpts from the AMLAS Version 1.1 guidance directly support all components of the claim. Specifically, AMLAS is introduced as a six-stage methodology for ML components (S-CHAL-004-R1), explicitly links system-level hazard/risk analysis to ML safety requirements across its stages (S-CHAL-004-R1), states its scope is limited to the ML component (S-CHAL-004-R2), advises against its use in isolation (S-CHAL-004-R2), and confirms a primary focus on off-line supervised learning (S-CHAL-004-R3). The source's publication date (2021-03) and status as research guidance are consistent with the claim's scope and date.
evidence_locators: PDF pp. 2–3, Introduction and Overview of AMLAS
